claims.evidence: No date or usage history visible in photo; single static image cannot confirm usage duration.
No ruler, reference object, or scale marker in photo 0 to confirm dimensions.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only one angle of the sofa front; fabric close-up, back, underside and seat compression are not visible.
Odor and environmental exposure cannot be assessed from a photo.

risks.risk: Fabric may have hidden stains, tears, or discoloration not visible in the single front-facing shot
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seat, armrests, back, and underside in natural light
risks.if_unproven: priced as having visible wear/stains (worst case for a used sofa)

risks.risk: Foam/cushion support may be worn or sagging despite claim of firmness
risks.proof: Video of someone sitting on the sofa or pressing down on cushions

risks.risk: Actual dimensions may not match the 'over 4 feet' claim
risks.proof: Photo of sofa with a tape measure or known-size object beside it
risks.if_unproven: priced using minimum standard 2-seater dimensions, not assumed to be larger

risks.risk: Age/usage history inconsistent or unverifiable (bought new last year vs used 3 months only)
risks.proof: Purchase receipt or original packaging photo with date
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age, standard used condition

risks.risk: Smoke or pet exposure affecting fabric/odor, not detectable remotely
risks.proof: No remote proof possible; only in-person inspection can confirm
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible odor exposure, no premium for 'smoke-free' claim

risks.risk: Frame condition (cracks, wobbling, structural damage) hidden by upholstery
risks.proof: Video showing sofa being shaken or lifted from one side
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified frame integrity, standard used risk

proof_requests: Close-up photos of fabric (seat, armrests, back, underside) in good lighting
Photo with a tape measure or standard object for scale to confirm length
Short video of someone sitting on the sofa to show cushion firmness and frame stability
Photo of purchase receipt or date-stamped proof of purchase if available
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a 2-seater sofa, so pricing is possible, but all seller claims about condition, age, and dimensions remain unverified or unverifiable remotely, so it must be priced at worst-case used condition pending further proof.
